recommendations.name: GitHub native auto-merge with branch protection and SHA-pinned merges
recommendations.description: Keep required checks and reviews on with no bypass for the bot, dismiss stale reviews, use a review-only token, and pin the merge to the reviewed head SHA so any later push blocks the merge.

recommendations.name: Gate with a risk-tiered, size-limited AI approver (Intercom pattern)
recommendations.description: Only auto-approve small, low-risk PRs, send large or sensitive ones to a human, label and log every AI approval, and pilot on about 100 PRs before scaling.

recommendations.name: Dash0 AutoMerge (dry-run first)
recommendations.description: A ready-made tool that starts in dry-run mode where it only comments its decision, never approves a PR with failing CI, and does not let a PR rewrite its own rules.
